title: Laleli Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Exact named Laleli Camii outer polygon. The interior courtyard remains open in the model.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain below the northwestern approach to the raised mosque and court.

mapIdentity.provider: Named native Laleli Camii multipolygon with its open interior court.
mapIdentity.scope: The named Laleli Camii relation fixes the outer walls and the open court. Published measurements establish the 12.50 m main dome diameter and 24.50 m interior height. Relations of the hall, court and northwestern entry follow the mapped axis.

note: The current Qualla original shows stone and brick striped walls, the tall drum and lead-clad dome, open side gallery and carved minaret collar. The Turkish conservation inventory documents the six half-domes, eighteen courtyard dome bays, raised base, two single-balcony minarets and fountain.
